name: Secure the Mountain

angles.text: As a dwarf, you rely on Dun Morogh's mountaineers to patrol snowy ridges and perilous caves. Their reports help keep dwarven settlements safe.
As an Alliance member, you help local dwarven patrols around Kharanos coordinate defenses across the snowy heart of Khaz Modan.

faq.answer: Senir Whitebeard gives the request in Kharanos. Mountaineer Gretchen calls him 'Ol' Whitebeard.' He gathers reports on wilderness threats and sends them to Ironforge's dwarven leaders.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Secure the Mountain?

faq.answer: Mountaineer Gretchen is just west of Kharanos in Dun Morogh. She is near the mountainsides and caves where wendigos threaten the area.
faq.q: Where can Mountaineer Gretchen be found?

faq.answer: Senir Whitebeard sends intelligence to Ironforge, but a scout investigating the wendigos has not reported back on time. He is behind schedule and will not enter dangerous caves, so he asks you to check on Mountaineer Gretchen.
faq.q: Why is the questgiver looking for Mountaineer Gretchen?

faq.answer: Wendigos live in the rocky foothills and dark caves around Kharanos. Their aggression threatens travelers and local outposts, so Ironforge scouts watch their movements closely.
faq.q: What wendigo problem is threatening the area?

faq.answer: West of town, Mountaineer Gretchen confirms she received Whitebeard's inquiries. She says the nearby wendigos have made a serious mess of things.
faq.q: What does Mountaineer Gretchen report upon arrival?

faq.answer: Mountaineers guard borders, track threats, and scout for the Ironforge dwarves. They survey remote passes, dark caves, and snowy trails across Dun Morogh to protect towns like Kharanos.
faq.q: What role do mountaineers play around Kharanos?

sections.body: Senir Whitebeard gathers military reports for Ironforge. A team of mountaineers went to study the wendigos nearby, but they have not returned with news. Whitebeard will not enter the icy caves himself. So he asks you to travel just west of town and learn what became of the scouts.
sections.title: An Overdue Report

sections.body: West of Kharanos, Mountaineer Gretchen has received Senir Whitebeard's inquiries. She says the wendigos in the mountain crags are more volatile than the first reports claimed. The danger now calls for closer scouting in the nearby wilds.
sections.title: Trouble on the Western Ridge

summary: Senir Whitebeard needs news from Mountaineer Gretchen, west of Kharanos. The scouts he sent to investigate aggressive wendigos have not reported back.
attribution: In-game quest text: Secure the Mountain
